<think>
Manager is at position 1 (far left).
Manager left of peach eater. Manager not left of chess - so manager position >= chess position. Manager is at 1, so chess is at 1.
So person 1: manager, chess.

Engineer is far left or far right. Manager is at 1, so engineer is at 3.
Project-manager at 2.

Engineer (pos 3, odd) and peach same parity - peach at 1 or 3. Manager left of peach, so peach at 3.
Engineer and skydiving different parity - skydiving at position 2.
So rock-climbing at 3.

Wait, person 1 has chess, so skydiving and rock-climbing are at 2,3. Skydiving at 2, rock-climbing at 3.

House listener immediate left/right of chess person (pos 1), so house at pos 2.
Spinach = r&b. Peach at 3. So spinach at 1 or 2. House at 2, so r&b at 1 or 3.
If spinach at 1, then r&b at 1. Person 2 eats cabbage.
If spinach... pos 2 has house not r&b. So spinach at 1, r&b at 1.
Person 3 listens to folk.

Spinach person = manager (pos 1).
Cabbage person at 2 = project-manager.
</think>

Looking at this step-by-step:

1. Manager is at position 1 (far left).
2. Manager isn't left of chess person, so chess is at position 1.
3. Engineer is far left or right; since manager is at 1, engineer is at 3. Project-manager is at 2.
4. Engineer (pos 3, odd) and peach have same parity. Manager left of peach, so peach is at position 3.
5. Engineer (odd) and skydiving have different parity, so skydiving is at position 2. Rock-climbing at 3.
6. House listener is adjacent to chess (pos 1), so house is at position 2.
7. Spinach = r&b. Position 2 has house, position 3 has peach, so spinach/r&b at position 1.
8. Position 3 listens to folk. Position 2 eats cabbage.

Answers:
- Project-manager: position 2
- Position 3 music: folk
- Spinach person's job: manager
- Cabbage person's job: project-manager

<solution>2, folk, manager, project-manager</solution>
